main_directions: Advanced Architectures for Intelligent Agents and Reasoning

clusters.name: Advanced Architectures for Intelligent Agents and Reasoning
clusters.description: This research cluster investigates specialized mechanisms to enhance artificial intelligence performance, focusing on reasoning-based language models and communicative strategies in multi-agent systems. It explores how targeted architectures, such as distilled reasoning models and structured communication protocols, can outperform traditional scaling or uncoordinated learning approaches.
